body.name: Feasible unstudentized Gaussian-max path band
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat\zeta_i\) as the observable plug-in counterpart of the population row influence \(\zeta_T(\xi_i)\), apply the same forward derivative \(D\Psi_T\) to obtain \(\widehat\psi_{\theta,T,i}\), and set \(\widehat\Omega_\theta=N^{-1}\sum_i\widehat\psi_{\theta,T,i}\widehat\psi_{\theta,T,i}^{\top}\), targeting exactly \(\Omega_\theta=P_\xi[\psi_{\theta,T}(\xi)\psi_{\theta,T}(\xi)^{\top}]\). Draw \(Z^\theta\mid\text{data}\sim\mathcal N(0,\widehat\Omega_\theta)\), take the conditional \(1-\alpha\) quantile of \(\max_{1\le t\le T}|Z_t^\theta|\), and report \(\mathcal C_N\) without estimating an active set or dividing by a variance.
